entries.label: business administration
entries.guidance: Keep the construct-state t of idārat clearly audible, then link to al-aʿmāl. No vowel between t and the article.

entries.label: government
entries.guidance: End with a short a, without t, tu, tun or another syllable.

entries.label: I enjoy
entries.guidance: Clearly pronounce voiced pharyngeal ayn in astamtiʿu. End that verb with short u, then short bi.

entries.label: boring
entries.guidance: Pronounce mu-mill, short i and a clearly doubled final l; no added vowel.

entries.label: king
entries.guidance: Trim initial silence only.

entries.label: since; ago
entries.guidance: Pronounce mun-dhu. The final short u is required; dh is voiced interdental, not z.

entries.label: sea
entries.guidance: Pronounce baḥr only ONCE; end on r without an added vowel.

entries.label: tour
entries.guidance: Pronounce jawla with pausal final a, not t and no case ending.

entries.label: I proposed marriage
entries.guidance: Begin with the voiceless velar/uvular fricative kh, never f. Keep final short u.

entries.label: hotels
entries.guidance: The last consonant is a clear voiceless uvular qaf q, never t or k. Stop after q, no extra syllable.

entries.label: being cut off; disconnection
entries.guidance: Start in-qi without extra syllables before it. End with pharyngeal ayn, no case ending.

entries.label: together
entries.guidance: Begin with a clear bilabial m, not n. Pronounce the written final an.

entries.label: taking
entries.guidance: Pronounce akhdh: a then kh then voiced interdental dh, without extra vowels or words.

entries.label: I visit
entries.guidance: Use long ū after z, not long ā. Keep the written final short u.

entries.label: I was appointed
entries.guidance: Pronounce ʿuy-yin-tu; no a or other vowel between n and t. Clearly pronounce initial ayn.

entries.label: being absent; absence
entries.guidance: Pronounce ta-ghay-yub exactly once. Use voiced velar/uvular fricative gh and a doubled y.

entries.label: I decided to
entries.guidance: Clearly pronounce initial uvular qaf q, and doubled r. Keep tu then an.

entries.label: decision
entries.guidance: Begin with a clear uvular qaf q, not a glottal stop, k or silence.

entries.label: I spend time
entries.guidance: Pronounce aq-ḍī, with a q-ḍ consonant cluster. No a or other vowel between q and ḍ.

entries.label: spending time
entries.guidance: Begin with clear uvular qaf q. End with the written glottal stop hamza, without a case vowel.

entries.label: death
entries.guidance: Pronounce wafāh/wafā, with pausal taa marbuuta. Never add a t or case vowel.

entries.label: I returned
entries.guidance: Clearly finish with the written short u in -tu. Do not stop at t.

entries.label: I encourage someone to
entries.guidance: Make both voiced pharyngeal ayn consonants audible, one in ushajjiʿu and one at the start of ʿalā.

entries.label: beliefs; suppositions
entries.guidance: Begin with MSA emphatic voiced INTERDENTAL fricative ẓ (pharyngealized dh), not plain z.

entries.label: Nice to meet you
entries.guidance: Pronounce furṣa saʿīda without tanween or case vowels. Both taa marbuutas are pausal a, not t.

entries.label: I left
entries.guidance: The second word is min with bilabial m, not nin. Retain short u in kharajtu.

entries.label: past; last
entries.guidance: Clearly pronounce the l of the article al before m, never n. Final ī is long.

entries.label: I help
entries.guidance: Pronounce u-sā-ʿi-du, with no extra syllable before the initial u. Make ayn audible.

entries.label: basketball
entries.guidance: Keep the linking t of kurat as this is idaafa, but add NO u or other case vowel after it. Final salla ends in a, not t.
